description: This file defines the interface ChargeReadPlatformService, which declares methods for retrieving various charge-related data in the Fineract platform, including charges for loans, savings, shares, and applicable penalties.

classes.name: ChargeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for reading charge data related to loans, savings, shares, and penalties in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: retrieveAllChargesForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves all charges for a specific currency.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific charge by ID.

methods.name: retrieveNewChargeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details necessary for creating a new charge.

methods.name: retrieveAllChargesApplicableToClients
methods.description: Retrieves all charges applicable to clients.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicableFees
methods.description: Retrieves all fees applicable for loans, excluding penalties.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for a specific loan account, excluding specified charge times.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for a specific loan product, excluding specified charge times.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicablePenalties
methods.description: Retrieves all penalties applicable for loans.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves all charges associated with a specific loan product.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges for a loan product filtered by charge time.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for savings products, optionally filtering for fee charges only.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges for a specific savings product.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for a specific savings account.

methods.name: retrieveSharesApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charge definitions applicable for shares.

methods.name: retrieveShareProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges for a specific share product.
